altText: Upright photograph of the Toitū Te Whenua Our Whakapapa exhibition panel headed 1960–1979, showing text and historical photographs.
caption: Toitū Te Whenua’s Our Whakapapa panel tracing metric mapping and early computer-assisted mapping during 1960–1979, photographed on 16 October 2026.
dateDisplay: Historical panel period: 1960–1979; photograph taken: 16 October 2026
context: The panel dates the Department of Lands and Survey Computer Mapping Unit to 1979 and names Chris Kinzett in its account of technical work. The unit is distinct from MAPPAK, which M. S. Colley’s 1979 thesis documents as a separate computer-assisted cadastral mapping system. The panel says the first NZMS 260 sheet was published in 1978; Te Ara identifies T12 Thames as published in 1977, and the site retains the 1977 date and existing event. The panel photograph was taken on 16 October 2026; that is the capture date, not the date of the historical events described. The original JPEG is preserved unchanged; the full-size display and card variants apply EXIF orientation 6 without cropping.
derivativesNote: The supplied original JPEG bytes are retained unchanged under the source filename. Its EXIF Orientation 6 is applied to the full-resolution WebP and the card WebP; both keep the complete panel in frame without cropping. The original can be downloaded from this page.
